thread:
Alex_M: Quick check — we need final signoffs for the tenant catalog marshalling and press cues. Cutover window is tomorrow 09:00-11:00 PT. Who's green on assets + infra?
Samir: I'm green on partner assets, landing content is staged. Just need legal to confirm partner logos.
Maya_D: Marketing is ready for the press embargo draft, sending to @legal in 10m. We still need the canonical CTA URL for the landing page (is it /marketplace/partners or /partners)?
Lorenzo: For infra: the catalog migration script completes in <30m in staging. I pushed a TTL on stale entries so we don't blow up tenant indices. Will run final dry-run at 07:30 PT.
Emily: @Maya_D CTA should be /marketplace/partners — SEO agreed. I'll update the microsite and wire the tracking tags.
Alex_M: Great. Two blockers: 1) SI partners want a region-specific pricing snippet and 2) press wants a short tech blurb for hardware partners. Who can draft?
Samir: I can draft the region pricing snippet — need a quick mapping from @Lorenzo on which regions are live for dedicated pools.
Lorenzo: Regions live: us-west1, us-east1, eu-west2. Dedicated pools for ap-southeast pending. I'll DM infra runbook link.
Maya_D: I'll draft the hardware blurb, short and non-technical. Can someone add a line about validated throughput? e.g., "validated up to 800 rps on T4-backed pools" — is that accurate?
Lorenzo: That's overstated for T4. Suggest: "validated at typical tenant loads; dedicated GPU profiles available for higher throughput" — keeps it safe.
Emily: Legal just replied in thread — logos good, embargo date is confirmed. Press ops wants final quote from CEO by 18:00 PT. Alex, can you nudge him? :eyes:
Alex_M: On it. I'll ping him in 5.
deploy-bot: NOTICE: staging cutover job #487 queued. ETA 07:30 PT. See /deploys/487 for logs.
Samir: Small ask — can marketing include an appendix with SI integration flow (1-2 diagrams)? Partners asked for it.
Maya_D: Yes. I can add a one-page integration flow. Samir, send me the topology you want highlighted.
Lorenzo: FYI running final migration dry-run now: logs show one tenant mapping conflict (legacy collection name). I'll fix and re-run; should be clear by 07:05 PT.
Emily: I'm toggling tracking flags to 'preview' once Lorenzo confirms migration is clean.
Alex_M: Plan summary: Lorenzo finishes dry-run + fixes by 07:15 PT, Samir finalizes pricing snippet by 12:00 PT, Maya final press blurb + SI appendix by 16:30 PT, Emily wires CTA and tracking asap after migration. CEO quote due 18:00 PT. If all green we'll proceed with cutover at 09:00 PT tomorrow. Any other blockers?
Samir: No blockers from my side.
Maya_D: None.
Lorenzo: I'll post in here when dry-run completes.
Emily: I'll confirm tracking test results in this thread after staging smoke.
Alex_M: Thanks team :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: JOB UPDATE: staging cutover #487 started at 07:30 PT, status: running.
